newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse turnover stays low, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse turnover stays low, prices mixed.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest stock exchange rose on Tuesday by 17 million lei from the previous level, but stayed low at 55.5 million in thin buying interest.
Two independent indexes slipped to year lows for the third consecutive session.
"Interest in existing stocks is still light with investors in a waiting mood as the bourse expects new listings," one trader said.
Volume was a modest 10,152 shares and prices were mixed.
"Several stocks marked time today, others picked up slightly so a rise in prices is to be expected, probably at the next session on Thursday," said another trader.

The bourse announced recently 14 companies had applied for listing but did not say when they would join in trading. It also said it would handle public offers for 14 state companies, with their shares subsequently traded on the exchange.
The stock exchange now trades 13 stocks.
Tuesday's low demand centred on fertiliser maker Azomures SA, which took 66 percent of overall turnover and closed 150 lei higher at 10,000.
The unofficial VAB and BIG value-weighted indexes of all listed stocks, computed by Vanguard SA securities and Bucharest Investment Group respectively, fell to year lows.
Both were 1.1 percent down from the previous session, with the VAB at 288.4 points and the BIG at 286.73 points. Their base was 1,000 points last November.
